item.title: OIL JUMPS AS TRUMP DECLARES CEASE-FIRE OVER Oil prices surged after President Trump said the Iran cease-fire was "over" following U.S. strikes and attacks on commercial ships near the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude rose 6.3% to $78.86 a barrel, while WTI gained 5.9% to $74.60 as investors weighed escalating geopolitical risks.
item.description:
OIL JUMPS AS TRUMP DECLARES CEASE-FIRE OVER

Oil prices surged after President Trump said the Iran cease-fire was "over" following U.S. strikes and attacks on commercial ships near the Strait of Hormuz.

Brent crude rose 6.3% to $78.86 a barrel, while WTI gained 5.9% to $74.60 as investors weighed escalating geopolitical risks.

item.title: TARIFF PRICE PRESSURE LINGERS Tariffs may keep pushing inflation higher, New York Fed researchers said. While many U.S. firms have already passed costs to customers, nearly half of tariff-paying businesses still plan more price hikes. Some firms are delaying increases because of long-term contracts or raising prices gradually to avoid shocking customers.
item.description:
TARIFF PRICE PRESSURE LINGERS

Tariffs may keep pushing inflation higher, New York Fed researchers said.

While many U.S. firms have already passed costs to customers, nearly half of tariff-paying businesses still plan more price hikes.

Some firms are delaying increases because of long-term contracts or raising prices gradually to avoid shocking customers.

item.title: IRAN WARNS ON HORMUZ Iran will close the Strait of Hormuz if it faces fresh attacks, according to Press TV. The report also said Iran would strike enemy targets at a ratio of at least two-to-one in response to any attack.
item.description:
IRAN WARNS ON HORMUZ

Iran will close the Strait of Hormuz if it faces fresh attacks, according to Press TV.

The report also said Iran would strike enemy targets at a ratio of at least two-to-one in response to any attack.
